propositions: PASS-path reuse (idempotent_reuse) synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar content, losing the last review's actual findings
BLOCK-path reuse (verdict_reuse) correctly replays stored blocking/advisory/coaching from the latest sidecar with a reused notation; PASS path must achieve parity

CLI notation must unmistakably indicate rendered findings are the last review's result replayed due to unchanged plan, not a fresh LLM run, and must include recency anchor (verified_at_sha/timestamp) when available

Replayed advisory/coaching/indeterminate and coverage counts must be read from stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar when it matches material fingerprint; fail-open to empty lists if sidecar is absent, unreadable, or mismatched
